stem.en: Sort each feature into the period it belongs to.

text.en: Animal bones cleaved to reach the marrow
Attirampakkam, about 1.5 to 1.7 million years ago
Fishing as the main source of food
Forests and grasslands spreading after the climate warmed

explanation.en: Palaeolithic people used large cutting tools, and the sites go back more than a million years. The Mesolithic began around 12,000 years ago, when a warmer climate brought new landscapes, more fishing and a sharp rise in population.

hints.en: Ask whether the feature comes before or after the climate warmed about 12,000 years ago.
